# Tuebor — Michigan Public Record

> I will defend. Evidence-based accountability documentation across Michigan courts, charter schools, and political networks. Every claim sourced to public records. 38 pages.

## About

Tuebor documents institutional failures across Michigan — courts ignoring evidence, oversight bodies failing to act, convicted felons running charter schools with sitting judges on their boards. This is not partisan. It is structural. When oversight stops working, the only defense left is the record itself.

Part of the [primals.eco](https://primals.eco) evidence network. Detroit node: [detroit.primals.eco](https://detroit.primals.eco).

## Sections

- [Actors](/actors/) — Sourced profiles of investigated individuals (attorneys, judges, political operatives)
- [Evidence](/evidence/) — Court records, domain forensics, FOIA analysis, financial documentation
- [Analysis](/analysis/) — Infrastructure studies, pattern analysis, enforcement ecosystem mapping
- [Investigate](/investigate/) — FOIA toolkits, oversight filing guides, court records guides
- [Timeline](/timeline/) — Chronological record from 1998 to present, every entry sourced
- [Desk](/desk/) — 3-panel workbench: sidebar, reader, context panel with inline article loading
- [Membrane](/membrane/) — Interactive dashboard: search, entity graph, cross-reference matrix

## Analysis — Infrastructure Studies

- [They Banked on Banks](/analysis/they-banked-on-banks/) — Brian Roderick Banks (ICHAT SID 2029469K): 9 convictions, 2 charter schools, fake attorney claim, parent access denied, PPO weaponized, board chaired by the judge in the court that processes the PPO.
- [Signal Permeability — Live Anderson Study](/analysis/signal-permeability/) — Live experiment: send evidence to every oversight body, then measure who opens it, who forwards it, who ignores it. The propagation pattern IS the data. Anderson localization in real time.
- [Hey Mikey, He Likes It!](/analysis/hey-mikey/) — Rogers authored America's most aggressive surveillance bill, got hired by the company whose competitor he investigated, bought a $1.6M house, and accepted $88.8M from dark money. Same donors fund Barrett. Same election.
- [Tommy Boy](/analysis/tommy-boy/) — Barrett calls his opponent a "convicted felon" (expunged). Barrett's PAC donor runs dark money with an actual convicted felon as president. FEC receipts.
- [The Enforcement Ecosystem](/analysis/enforcement-ecosystem/) — Ten oversight bodies have the mandate, the evidence, and the authority. None has the full picture. The network operates in the jurisdictional gaps.
- [How To Build an OS](/analysis/how-to-build-an-os/) — One law firm (Dykema), one compliance specialist, six dark money vehicles, both parties served.
- [Infrastructure Grid](/analysis/infrastructure-grid/) — Fluorescent tag map: every node where entity infrastructure touches individual privacy.
- [LakeNet Signal Trace](/analysis/lakenet-signal-trace/) — One IP, three captures, one ISP in a town of 1,500.
- [Anderson Localization — Hemlock](/analysis/anderson-hemlock/) — Same physics as Detroit, population 2,000.
